threads.text:
Mickey's Very Merry Christmas Party: 25 nights at Magic Kingdom

When: Select nights November 8 to December 22, 2026: November 8, 9, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19, 20, 24, 25, 27 and 29; December 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13, 15, 17, 18, 20 and 22.

Cost: USD 189 to USD 229 per ticket plus tax, by date. Children ages 3 to 9 pay USD 10 less per ticket.

A late night for young children: the party ends at midnight.

Checked on the official page October 28: Walt Disney World event page.

When: Select nights November 8 to December 22, 2026: November 8, 9, 12, 13, 15, 17, 19, 20, 24, 25, 27 and 29; December 1, 3, 4, 6, 8, 10, 11, 13, 15, 17, 18, 20 and 22. The party runs 7 p.m. to midnight; ticket holders may enter Magic Kingdom from 4 p.m.

threads.text:
Hyde Park Winter Wonderland: every visitor needs a booked entry slot

When: Every day from Thursday, November 19, 2026 to Sunday, January 3, 2027, except Christmas Day.

Cost: Off-Peak entry slots are free but must still be booked. Standard and Peak slots are paid; check the current price on the official ticket site.

The final day, January 3, 2027, is billed as a Family Fun Day; details were not yet published.

Checked on the official page October 28: Hyde Park Winter Wonderland tickets guide.
